title: fix: #5824 make the viewer wheel zoom proportional to scroll distance
issueTitle: [Bug] Viewer wheel zoom uses a fixed step per event, so one trackpad flick hits the zoom limit
why: The bug only shows up with wheel or trackpad gestures whose deltaY sizes and event counts depend on the platform, so a plain-English click-and-type test cannot reliably produce a zoom readout that differs between the fixed and buggy builds.
